## `GET /health`

Liveness check.

Returns `ok` when the API process is up. Does not check Postgres, Redis or Ollama.

Tags: `system`

Auth: none (public)

### Responses

#### 200

The API process is up.

| Field    | Type                 | Required | Description                                                  |
| -------- | -------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `source` | `"api" \| "fixture"` | yes      | Which backend answered: the real API or the Playwright stub. |
| `status` | `"ok"`               | yes      | Always `ok` when the process can serve requests.             |
